## Problem and user impact

Explain the problem and link any prior scope discussion.

## Change

Describe the focused change. Call out numerical behavior, dependencies, network access, build/install scripts or permission changes explicitly.

## Evidence

State the checks actually run and what remains untested. Include relevant synthetic tests, documentation checks or browser/package evidence. Do not attach private analytical data or logs.

## Contribution responsibility

Confirm you have reviewed and understand the submission and have the right to contribute it. Explain material AI-generated changes and how you checked them; do not include private prompts. Passing CI is not a promise of acceptance.
